name: moraisz/atria-core
description: Core runtime for the Atria PHP framework.

suggest.ext-pgsql: Required by the pgsql database driver.
suggest.ext-mysqli: Required by the mysql and mariadb database drivers.
suggest.ext-sqlite3: Required by the sqlite database driver.

ci: docker compose -f docker-compose.ci.yml run --rm --build php docker/ci/run.sh

scripts-descriptions.ci: Run the CI pipeline (validate, install, audit, cs-check, phpstan, tests with PostgreSQL and MySQL) in Docker.
scripts-descriptions.ci-down: Stop and remove the local CI containers and volumes.
